source: Slapshot Fantasy League (Fantrax glxjunc7mtxdqi8x): rules summary pasted by the user and the public fxea getLeagueInfo (2026-09-27); owner answers: every player carries over (no cutdown), any player may sit in the minors, salary cap 105 M$ in 2026-27 on the 20 active + 3 reserve (minors and IR free), real NHL cap hits, growth unknown -> NHL trajectory.

scoring.source: getLeagueInfo scoringSystem: skaters G 3.5, A 2.5, PPP 0.5, SHG 1, SOG 0.25; Hit (Default 0.15) and SB (Default 0.3) carry a 0 override on every roster slot (C, LW, RW, D, G) and flex positions score by slot, so both score 0. Goalies W 3, SV 0.25, GA -1, SHO 5, A 3. players.json has no SHG and no goalie GA: GA = saves (1 - sv%) / sv%; SHG = goals x the career share of short-handed goals in player-profiles.json (F 1,881 / 66,393 = 0.0283, D 239 / 11,659 = 0.0205); goalie assists 424 / 22,959 GP = 0.0185 per game.

roster.source: getLeagueInfo rosterInfo: C4 LW4 RW4 D6 G2 active (20), 3 reserve, 40 max; IR 5 and minors 17 do not count toward the roster limits (rules summary). Minors: no eligibility rule.

season.source: Fantasy regular season = scoring periods 1-82 (2026-09-29 .. 2027-02-25 18:59 ET); share of the 1,344 NHL games (public/fantrax/schedule-20262027.json) starting before its end: 1,003 / 1,344 = 0.746. Playoff periods 83-84 (4 teams) are left out. Assumed the same calendar every season.

cap.source: League cap 105 M$ in 2026-27 (commissioner rule). Growth unknown (owner): the NHL trajectory scaled to the league base, league_t = 105 x NHL_t / NHL_2026. NHL upper limit: 2025-26 95.5, 2026-27 104.0, 2027-28 113.5 (announced, NHL/NHLPA MOU 2025); after 2027-28 +5 %/season (assumption: the long-run HRR growth the escrow-free era would allow; the announced steps average +9 %). NHL minimum salary 2026-27: 0.85 M$ (the 5th percentile and the common floor of the 957 2026-27 cap hits in the capwages seasons; a few older two-way deals sit at 0.80-0.81), grown with the cap. A prospect without a contract signs an entry-level deal at 0.975 M$ (2024+ ELC maximum) for 3 seasons from his expected arrival.

lambda.source: Cap shadow price (league points per M$ above the league minimum). snake (default) = the λ = 0 points-optimal counting players (640 starters by an optimal seat fill + the next 96 as reserves) dealt to the 32 teams in snake order by expected points (12 draft orders: the plain one and 11 with a 15 % log-normal jitter); each team over the cap swaps starters for the best free agents at the fewest points lost per M$ saved until it fits; λ_team = the last swap's rate (0 under the cap); λ = the mean over teams and orders (a generic team before trades). aggregate = the league-wide Lagrangian (0 when the points-optimal set fits under 32 x cap, i.e. trades could move every surplus). Solved on each season's own pool (expected points and cap hits from the calibration pass) for the first solvedSeasons seasons (2026-27 with the real contracts, 2027-28 with the 9 % cap jump against mostly signed contracts); later seasons hold the last solved value per share of the cap (λ_t = λ_last C_last / C_t): their pools lack future draft classes and rest on projected contracts (the 2028-29 solve is reported as a diagnostic).

replacement.source: Optimal seat-by-seat fill (src/lib/leagues/slot-fill.ts, multi-eligibility) of 32 x C4/LW4/RW4/D6/G2 = 640 starting seats by expected 2026-27 league points; replacement = mean season points of the best 5 unseated skaters eligible at the position (goalies: best 3), skaters per NHL game over a regular's games (0.873 x 84). A multi-eligible skater is measured against his lowest replacement.

contracts.source: Projected contracts after the signed seasons: AAV = predicted share of that season's NHL cap (fitSalaryModel, OLS in log share on non-ELC contracts whose first season is 2023-24 .. 2027-28 from the capwages seasons, against today's level, role, age at signing and RFA status; median prediction), term by age at signing; UFA from 27. Ceiling: 17 % of the cap (the largest current deals: Celebrini 18.8 / 113.5 = 16.6 %, Carlsson 18 / 104 = 17.3 %, Kaprizov 17 / 104 = 16.3 %), 12 % when signing at 30+ (largest 2019-2026 deals signed at 30-45: 8.6-12.3 % of that season's cap). An unsigned prospect's entry-level deal: cap.elcCapHit for cap.elcYears from his expected arrival.
